calculationContract.massEquivalent: For positive input mass M and positive source range [m_min,m_max], equivalent counts span [M/m_max,M/m_min]. These are quantity equivalents, not counts of complete animals.
calculationContract.kineticEquivalent: For positive energy E, ideal speeds span [sqrt(2E/m_max),sqrt(2E/m_min)]. Preserve the whole biological mass range and existing motion/salience bounds; do not claim an animal can run at that speed or survive the scene.
